name: Checkout.com Payment Platform API
description: Checkout.com is a comprehensive payment platform API that enables merchants to accept payments, manage customers, handle disputes, issue cards, and orchestrate complex payment workflows. It supports multiple payment methods including cards, mobile wallets, bank transfers, and alternative payment methods across global markets.
